items.t: Colonial Lima and the San Francisco catacombs
items.resumen: As evening falls, you walk through Lima's historic center: from the Parque de la Muralla to the catacombs beneath the San Francisco convent, where thousands of Lima's residents were buried in colonial times. You pass the old train station and finish in the Plaza Mayor. Two hours to feel the Lima of the viceroys.
datos: Parque de la Muralla, Jr. Amazonas 101, Historic Center
itinerario: Parque de la Muralla: an introduction to Lima's culture and society, facing San Cristóbal Hill.
San Francisco church and convent: the cloister, the library and the underground catacombs. We taste Peruvian churros.
Casa de la Literatura: the old train station, Peru's native languages and its first railway (closed on Mondays).
Plaza Mayor: history and architecture in front of the Government Palace and the Cathedral.
noIncluye: Pickup from your accommodation (optional, extra cost): Barranco 3:40, Miraflores 3:45, San Isidro 3:55 and Downtown 4:00 p.m.
llevar: Physical passport, a clear photo of it or the document you entered Peru with (a driver's license is not valid)
notas: Not suitable for wheelchairs or strollers.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
On public holidays schedules may change and some places may close.

items.t: Larco Museum: Peru before the Incas
items.resumen: Before the Incas there were thousands of years of history. At the Larco Museum, an 18th-century mansion built on top of a pre-Columbian pyramid, you discover them with a guide: Andean religion, textiles, rituals, gold and the famous erotic gallery, the «Andean Kama Sutra».
datos: Main entrance of the Larco Museum
itinerario: Meet your guide at the main entrance.
Introduction to the history and religion of the Andes and Peru.
Erotic gallery, the «Andean Kama Sutra»: how ancient cultures thought.
Culture and textiles, sacrifice and death in ancient Peru, and the gold and jewelry room.
noIncluye: Pickup from your accommodation (optional, extra cost): Barranco 10:40, Miraflores 10:45, Downtown 10:50 and San Isidro 10:55 a.m.; return 1:15 p.m.
llevar: Physical passport, a clear photo of it or the document you entered Peru with (a driver's license is not valid)
notas: Arrive 10 minutes before the meeting time.
The museum is open every day from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
On public holidays schedules may change.

items.t: Huacachina: vineyard, dune buggies and a sunset picnic
items.resumen: A full day from Lima: lunch at the La Caravedo vineyard in Ica, where pisco has been made for more than 400 years; the Huacachina oasis; dune buggies and sandboarding across the dunes; and a picnic to watch the sun set over the desert.
datos: Between 6:20 and 6:45 a.m. from your accommodation in Downtown, San Isidro, Miraflores or Barranco
Around 11:00 p.m., to the same place
itinerario: Pickup and bus to Paracas, about a 4.5-hour ride.
Paracas: your guide meets you and you continue on their bus.
La Caravedo vineyard: tour, lunch and optional pisco tasting.
Huacachina oasis: free time to walk and take photos. You can order your dinner to take away.
Dune buggies across the dunes for two hours, with sandboarding.
Picnic on the dunes at sunset.
incluye: Pickup and drop-off at your accommodation
Bus with air conditioning, USB and restroom
Vineyard tour and lunch (vegetarian and vegan options)
Dune buggies and sandboarding, with helmet
llevar: Physical passport (send a photo 24 hours before)
notas: Minors need their parents' authorization for the dune buggies.
Travelers weighing over 100 kg pay for an extra seat in the buggy or the bus.
Pregnant travelers can only join on a private tour and up to the fourth month.
If it's cloudy, the sunset may not be visible.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
